name: BioSPPy ECG Heart Rate Pipeline
description: A concrete ECG pipeline that bandpass-filters a waveform, detects and corrects R peaks, rejects implausible intervals, and computes a robust heart-rate trace.
dejargonized_summary: Clean an ECG trace, find each heartbeat, correct and check the beat locations, then calculate a stable heart rate.
planning_constraints: Use this concrete graph only when ECG modality is established by the request or upstream evidence.
Preserve the filtered waveform until R-peak correction is complete.
Reject implausible intervals before the final lossy rate calculation.

stages.name: Bandpass Filter ECG
stages.description: Apply the reviewed BioSPPy FIR bandpass filter to the ECG waveform.
stages.dejargonized_description: Remove baseline drift and high-frequency noise while preserving heartbeat timing.

stages.name: Detect ECG R Peaks
stages.description: Detect R-peak sample indices with the reviewed BioSPPy Hamilton detector wrapper.
stages.dejargonized_description: Locate each heartbeat in the cleaned ECG trace.

stages.name: Correct ECG R Peaks
stages.description: Correct candidate R-peak locations against the filtered waveform.
stages.dejargonized_description: Nudge detected beats onto the best nearby waveform location.

stages.name: Reject Implausible ECG Intervals
stages.description: Remove R peaks that create physiologically implausible or strongly outlying beat intervals.
stages.dejargonized_description: Discard beat locations that would imply implausible timing.

stages.name: Compute Robust ECG Heart Rate
stages.description: Compute instantaneous heart rate from cleaned R peaks and apply median smoothing.
stages.dejargonized_description: Turn the checked heartbeat locations into a stable beats-per-minute trace.

audit.rationale: Promotes the reviewed BioSPPy ECG atoms into a concrete graph without specializing the generic signal-event-rate family.
audit.dejargonized_summary: This is the ECG-specific implementation. Generic waveform-rate tasks should continue to use the generic family scaffold.
provenance_notes: Provider-owned concrete solution assembled from catalog-ready BioSPPy ECG atoms.
uncertainty_notes: Requires ECG modality evidence and should not be selected for unlabeled generic waveforms.
